channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Hamilton: Ferrari waxay ku jirtaa xilli aad u adag kadib shilkii isaga iyo Leclerc ee Las Vegas
item.description: Darawalka Ferrari Lewis Hamilton ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu ay wajahayso xilli aad iyo aad u adag, kadib dhacdooyin isdaba-joog ah oo dhex maray isaga iyo saaxiibkiis kooxda Charles Leclerc.

item.title: Zelensky oo ka digay weerar weyn oo Ruushku ku qaadi doono shabakadda korontada Ukraine
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in Ruushku uu u diyaar garoobayo weerar kale oo weyn oo lagu beegsanayo kaabayaasha tamarta, gaadiidka iyo adeegyada muhiimka ah ee Ukraine.

item.title: Dhaqaalaha Argentina oo galay hoos-u-dhac farsamo inkastoo ay socdaan dib-u-habeynta Javier Milei
item.description: Dhaqaalaha Argentina ayaa galay hoos-u-dhac farsamo, kadib markii uu yaraaday 2 rubuc oo isku xiga, iyadoo xogta rasmiga ah muujisay in uu 1.8% hoos u dhacay inta u dhaxeysa July iyo September.

item.title: Laba muwaadin oo Talyaani ah oo ku dhintay weerar Iran ay ku qaadday xarun ku taal Kuwait
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Talyaaniga ayaa Khamiistii sheegtay in laba muwaadin oo Talyaani ah ay ku dhinteen weerar Iran ay ku qaadday xarun ku taal dalka Kuwait.

item.title: Kenya oo Garissa ka furtay cutub booliis oo degdeg loogu jawaabo amni darrada waqooyiga
item.description: Ku-xigeenka Sarkaalka Guud ee Booliiska Kenya, Eliud Lagat, ayaa si rasmi ah u daahfuray Cutubka Jawaabta Degdegga ah (QRU) ee Booliiska Kenya, wuxuuna xilka u dhaariyay taliyihii ugu horreeyay ee cutubka, kaas oo xaruntiisu noqon doonto Garissa.

item.title: Davis Cup: Ingiriiska oo 2-1 ku reebay Jarmalka Zverev, una gudbay semi-finalka
item.description: Xulka Ingiriiska ayaa Khamiistii 2-1 kaga adkaaday Jarmalka rubuc-finalka Davis Cup Finals ee Bologna, iyadoo guusha Cameron Norrie iyo ciyaarta labada-labada ay go'aamiyeen kulanka.

item.title: Laura Freigang oo laga mamnuucay kubadda ilaa October 2027, kana maqnaan doonta Koobka Adduunka Haweenka
item.description: Weerarka xulka haweenka Jarmalka Laura Freigang ayaa la hakiyay ilaa 7 October 2027 kadib markii ay seddex jeer ka maqnayd baaritaannada daroogada, taas oo ka dhigaysa inay seegi doonto Koobka Adduunka Haweenka ee 2027 ee Brazil.

item.title: Aubameyang oo shil gaari ku galay isagoo u socday tababarka Deportivo, kana badbaaday dhaawac
item.description: Weeraryahanka Deportivo de La Coruña Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang ayaa Khamiistii subaxnimo shil gaari ku galay waddada AP-9 isagoo u socday xarunta tababarka kooxda, iyadoo aan cidna ku dhaawacmin.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo hirgelinaysa nidaam amniga duulista ah oo waafaqsan heerarka Bariga Afrika
item.description: Maareeyaha Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliyeed, Axmed Macallin Xasan, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay hirgelinayso nidaam amniga duulista rayidka ah oo la jaanqaadaya heerarka Hay'adda Amniga Duulista Rayidka ee Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC-CASSOA).

item.title: Spain iyo France oo kulanka rubuc-finalka Nations League ku ciyaari doona Mestalla, sagootinta garoonka
item.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Spain ayaa Khamiistii ku dhawaaqay in lugta koowaad ee rubuc-finalka UEFA Nations League ee Spain iyo France, oo dhici doonta 25 March, lagu ciyaari doono garoonka Mestalla ee magaalada Valencia.

item.title: Jilaaga Faransiiska Gérard Depardieu oo maxkamad la horgeyn doono eedeymo kufsi ah
item.description: Jilaaga caanka ah ee Faransiiska Gérard Depardieu ayaa la horgeyn doonaa maxkamad, isagoo lagu eedeeyay inuu sannadkii 2018 kufsaday jilaaddii Charlotte Arnould, sida uu Khamiistii sheegay qareenkiisa David-Olivier Kaminski.

item.title: Xiddigga kubadda koleyga Koonfur Suudaan Wenyen Gabriel oo qalliin jilibka lagu sameeyay
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka kubadda koleyga Koonfur Suudaan Wenyen Gabriel ayaa qalliin lagu sameeyay jilibka bidix kadib dhaawac seed (ACL), waxaana la filayaa inuu seego diyaargarowga xulka Bright Stars ee kulamada isreebreebka Koobka Adduunka ee February 2027.

item.title: Juventus iyo Omonia: Neto oo goolka dib ugu laabanaya 3,480 maalmood kadib, Ekhator oo bilaabaya
item.description: Tababaraha Juventus Luciano Spalletti ayaa shaaciyay liiska 23 ciyaaryahan ee kulanka caawa Europa League ee Omonia Nicosia, iyadoo goolhayaha Neto iyo weeraryahanka da'da yar Jeff Ekhator la filayo inay bilaabaan.

item.title: Abiy oo baarlamaanka u sheegay in Eritrea ay diiday dalabyo koronto, waddooyin iyo dekedo
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Ahmed ayaa Khamiistii Golaha Wakiillada Shacabka u sheegay in Eritrea ay diiday dalabyo horumarineed oo Itoobiya u soo jeedisay, wuxuuna Asmara ku eedeeyay inay hub u gudbiso kooxaha ka soo horjeeda Itoobiya.

item.title: Goolhayaha Inter Josep Martinez oo codsaday heshiis xukun hal sano ah oo ku saabsan shilkii Fenegrò
item.description: Goolhayaha Inter Milan Josep Martinez ayaa codsaday heshiis xukun (patteggiamento) oo ah hal sano oo xabsi laalan ah, kiiska shilkii gaariga ee October 2025 uu ku dhintay nin 81 jir ah, iyadoo xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Como uu ogolaaday codsigaas.

item.title: Borussia Mönchengladbach oo si degdeg ah xilka uga qaaday agaasimaha guud Stefan Stegemann
item.description: Kooxda Borussia Mönchengladbach, oo ku jirta kaalinta ugu hooseysa Bundesliga, ayaa Khamiistii 26 November ku dhawaaqday inay si degdeg ah u kala tageen agaasimaha guud Dr. Stefan Stegemann.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo Imaaraadka ku eedeysay inuu Boosaaso u maray in ka badan 6,000 oo dagaalyahan Colombian ah
item.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeysay inuu magaalada Boosaaso u adeegsaday marin ay in ka badan 6,000 oo calooshood-u-shaqeystayaal Colombian ah uga gudbeen dagaalka Suudaan, eedeyn uu Abu Dhabi hore u beeniyay.

item.title: Diyaaradda Beşiktaş oo hillaac ku dhacay, loona leexiyay Rize kahor kulanka Europa League
item.description: Diyaaradda gaarka ah ee kooxda Beşiktaş ayaa Khamiistii 26 November dhowr jeer hillaac ku dhacay iyadoo u socotay Batumi ee Georgia, waxaana loo leexiyay garoonka Rize-Artvin ee Turkiga kahor kulanka Europa League ee Hapoel Beer Sheva.

item.title: Salva Kiir oo xiray wadahadalka axsaabta, xisbiyaduna oggolaadeen khariidadda doorashada 2027
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa Khamiistii 26 November si rasmi ah u xiray wadahadalka xisbiyada siyaasadda ee Juba, iyadoo xisbiyada ka qaybgalay ay ansixiyeen go'aanno ku saabsan doorashooyinka guud ee loo qorsheeyay 11 February 2027.

item.title: Kubadda gacanta: Goolhayaha Jarmalka Andreas Wolff oo 2028 ka dhaqaaqaya THW Kiel kuna biiraya Gummersbach
item.description: Goolhayaha xulka qaranka Jarmalka ee kubadda gacanta, Andreas Wolff, ayaa heshiis afar sano ah u saxiixay kooxda VfL Gummersbach, wuxuuna ka iman doonaa THW Kiel sannadka 2028.

item.title: Marseille: Timothy Weah iyo Geoffrey Kondogbia oo ka maqan kulanka Levski Sofia
item.description: Tababaraha Olympique de Marseille, Bruno Genesio, ayaa Khamiistii 26 November shaaciyay 23 ciyaaryahan oo loogu yeeray kulanka Levski Sofia ee Europa League, iyadoo kabtanka Timothy Weah iyo Geoffrey Kondogbia aysan ku jirin.

item.title: Museveni oo la filayo inuu Muqdisho yimaado: Xalane mise Madaxtooyada? Su'aalo xasaasi ah oo ku xeran booqashadiisa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Museveni, ayaa la filayaa inuu 2-da December 2026 yimaado Muqdisho, iyadoo la isweydiinayo halka uu kula kulmi doono Xasan Sheekh iyo haddii booqashadu ka baxsan doonto amniga iyo xiriirka labada dal.

item.title: AFC oo baaritaan ku billowday garsoore laga beddelay nasashada kulanka Al Jazira iyo Gol Gohar
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta Aasiya (AFC) ayaa baaritaan ku billaabay xaaladda garsooraha Suuriyaanka ah Hanna Hattab, kadib markii laga beddelay nasashada kulanka Al Jazira iyo Gol Gohar ee AFC Champions League Two oo ka dhacay Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Oliver Bearman oo heshiis cusub la saxiixday Haas, kooxda ayuu u kaxayn doonaa 2027
item.description: Darawalka reer Britain ee Oliver Bearman, oo 21 jir ah, ayaa sii joogi doona kooxda Haas ee Formula 1 xilli-ciyaareedka 2027, kadib markii kooxdu Khamiistii ku dhawaaqday heshiiskiisa cusub, bilowga toddobaadka Qatar Grand Prix.

item.title: Qarax ka dhacay kayd shidaal oo ku yaal bariga Bangkok, dadka deegaanka oo laga codsaday inay ka guuraan
item.description: Qarax xooggan ayaa Khamiistii ka dhacay kayd shidaal oo ku yaal bariga magaalada Bangkok ee dalka Thailand, kaas oo cirka u diray olol weyn iyo qiiq madow oo culus, halka mas'uuliyiinta deegaanka ay dadka ku nool agagaarka ku boorriyeen inay isla markiiba ka guuraan.

item.title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Rwanda oo dulsaarka u kordhiyay 9.5% si loo xakameeyo sicir-bararka
item.description: Bangiga Qaranka ee Rwanda (BNR) ayaa Khamiistii 26 November heerka dulsaarka bangiga dhexe ka qaaday 8.75% una qaaday 9.5%, kadib markii sicir-bararku gaaray 19.5% bishii October, una badan kor u kaca qiimaha cuntada.

item.title: Frank Garcia oo ku wareegaya Afrika: Mas'uulka diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ee Afrika oo ku wajahan Uganda
item.description: Mas'uulka ugu sarreeya diblomaasiyadda Mareykanka ee Afrika, Frank W. Garcia Jr., ayaa la sheegay inuu ku wajahan yahay Uganda, xilli Washington ay dib u habeyneyso siyaasaddeeda Afrika ee ku saleysan ganacsi, maalgashi iyo amni.

item.title: Joan Mir oo ku soo laabanaya MotoGP-ga tartanka Valencia, kaas oo noqonaya kii ugu dambeeyay ee uu u kaxeeyo Honda
item.description: Darawalka reer Spain ee Joan Mir ayaa loo oggolaaday inuu ka qayb galo tartanka ugu dambeeya xilli-ciyaareedka MotoGP ee Valencia, kaas oo noqonaya tartankiisii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda Honda HRC ka hor inta uusan u wareegin Ducati Gresini.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cirro oo Hargeysa dib ugu soo laabtay kadib 17 maalmood oo uu Imaaraadka ku maqnaa
item.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa Khamiistii 26 November dib ugu soo laabtay Hargeysa, kadib safar ku dhow 17 maalmood oo uu ku joogay Imaaraadka Carabta, xilli uu khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi heer sare marayo.

item.title: Real Madrid oo noqotay kooxdii ugu horreysay ee u gudubta wareegga xiga ee Champions League
item.description: Waxaa la xaqiijiyay inay u gudubtay wareegga knockout-ka ee Champions League, iyadoo 15 dhibcood ka heshay shanteeda kulan ee wareegga horyaalka, kadib natiijooyinkii Arbacada oo ay ku jirtay barbardhaca PSG iyo Roma.
